ctx.x: Between 14 and 16. I met Ziegfeld. Oh, a wonderful thing about Ziegfeld, I heard them talking in the dressing room that whenever he found a good singer like Sarah or Ella he'd really make a singer by introducing this singer to a very handsome, tall, handsome good-looking guy and the minute he felt that she was in love with this man, he'd snatch the man away from her. He'd say, "Now go out and sing!" She'd never see the man again. He'd say, "Now you'll sing with more feeling." He had his way of dealing with people…
When you knew Florence Mills, what was she doing then?
